# Create the Sprint Plan

Prerequisite: the Data Model, API Contract, and User Stories have explicit
human approval.

Create or update only `docs/planning/sprint-plan.md`. Prioritize a demonstrable
local user journey, sequence dependencies, allocate work across four days,
define exit criteria, identify risks and mitigations, and trace planned work
to approved stories. Fit Must scope first and clearly defer optional items.
Avoid invented hour estimates or unsupported parallelism.

End with a scope and dependency review checklist. Stop before Development.
